markets.title: Will a Google Gemini model rank #1 on LMSYS Chatbot Arena leaderboard on December 31, 2026?
markets.description: This market resolves to YES if any model officially released by Google Gemini is listed as rank #1 (or tied for #1) on the English LMSYS Chatbot Arena Leaderboard on Dec 31, 2026, 11:59 PM EST. Otherwise, NO.
markets.resolution_rules: This market resolves to YES if any model officially released by Google Gemini is listed as rank #1 (or tied for #1) on the English LMSYS Chatbot Arena Leaderboard on Dec 31, 2026, 11:59 PM EST. Otherwise, NO.

markets.title: Will OpenAI announce GPT-5 before December 31, 2026?
markets.description: This market resolves to YES if OpenAI officially announces a frontier model explicitly named 'GPT-5' or designated as the direct major successor to GPT-4/GPT-4o on or before Dec 31, 2026, 11:59 PM EST. Otherwise, NO.
markets.resolution_rules: This market resolves to YES if OpenAI officially announces a frontier model explicitly named 'GPT-5' or designated as the direct major successor to GPT-4/GPT-4o on or before Dec 31, 2026, 11:59 PM EST. Otherwise, NO.

markets.title: Will ChatGPT monthly active users decrease in 2026?

markets.resolution_rules: This market resolves to YES if ChatGPT's monthly active users (MAU) as reported by Similarweb or a mutually agreed analyst report falls below the December 2025 baseline in any month of 2026. Otherwise, NO.

markets.resolution_rules: This market resolves to YES if the United States Congress passes, and the President signs into law, a federal bill establishing binding safety compliance audits or licensing requirements for AI frontier models in 2026. Otherwise, NO.
